remarks: 独立透明PNG，界面文字与数值另设
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. One independent game bitmap component for 茶园物语. CLEAN Chinese hand-painted pale watercolor with sparse fine warm-gray/brown ink outlines, light ivory-gray #EEECE5, pale gray-jade #BCC6BE, muted gray tea green #98A38F, ash bamboo taupe #C7B69E. Smooth broad color fields, minimal two-tone shading, restrained brushwork. NO speckle, paper grain, wood grain, drybrush scratches, dense texture, muddiness, excessive saturation, photorealism or thick black lines.
True RGBA TRANSPARENT background. Only requested subject; generous transparent margins on all four sides, entire silhouette uncut. No white/paper/black backdrop, checkerboard, halo, glow, cast shadow, vignette, labels, words, numbers, watermarks or extra objects. All decorative form restrained. Preserve clarity at small game size. Palette follows the supplied final game scene: elegant pale ivory, restrained gray sage green and ash honey taupe. Enough gentle color to avoid looking desaturated; approximately 25% more color strength than the earlier overly gray palette. High luminance. No vivid cyan or candy colors.
Subject: exactly ONE blank main-menu green button base. Image 1 shows the ORIGINAL game's title screen, use only the bottom-center green start-button shape as design reference. Image 2 is the final palette reference. Long front-view horizontal button about 4.8:1; gently cloud-lobed rounded ends, smooth symmetric silhouette, thin subdued ivory and bamboo-gold double rim, quiet medium gray sage tea-green fill with only a broad lighter top band. Traditional Chinese hand-painted elegance. Remove the original leaf badge, characters, all text and tiny side glyphs. No icon, no round left badge, no center ornament. No scene, logo, white background, shadow, glow or texture. Place this one blank button centered on transparent landscape canvas with generous padding.
